name: Bristol County, MA
findings: Bristol County has 1,495 nonprofit organizations. 526 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 424 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bristol County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bristol County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list public events
observations.text: 7 professional organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 22 would.
